name: Get Your Driver's License!
desc:
Wait in line and get your Driver's License!

🎟️ Take a number and wait your turn
📝 Pass the written test
🚦 Drive the test course: cows, ducks, ramps and more
🎁 Win 1 of 18 cars, from rusty hatchbacks to secret supercars
🏅 Unlock every ending, from Honor Roll to Towed
📋 Be the Examiner and judge other players' driving

Can you get your license?
